eras.title: A street on Byrsa Hill
eras.caption: On Byrsa Hill, low walls trace the rooms and narrow streets of Punic Carthage. These domestic remains belong to the city Rome destroyed in 146 BCE, beneath the later Roman capital built on the same ground.
